runtime isolation inspected on restart only; first launch has identical recorded argv
nonzero child UID is an observation, not host-identity separation proof

observations: Confirm change rewrites the project file (hash changes, schema/history state) but the saved note row keeps its previous content; the note row changes only after the toolbar Save (all three cells, create and edit).
After the toolbar Save the notes editor shows the first note again (screenshot), not the edited one; the edited note was re-selected for the exact readback.
Cancel preview keeps the draft (still dirty); the draft is dropped by Reload notes + Discard draft, after which UI and file both show the unchanged stored note.

At 150% and 80% some controls (Preview change, Confirm change, Reload notes, Discard draft) fell outside the scroll viewport (AT-SPI SHOWING=false); the driver scrolled them into view with AT-SPI scroll_to before activating. That is a reachability observation, not a product-bug claim.
Typed text readback used the AT-SPI text interface of the Title and Note text entries; text was typed with wtype into the guarded owned window.
notAcceptedAttempts: launcher-exited-with-controller-script: first launch died with its parent (bwrap die-with-parent); harness mistake, retained, relaunched with a persistent launcher.

c100 first create: Confirm change was offscreen (SHOWING=false); run aborted before commit, draft discarded manually; a retried run then typed into a retained draft (doubled text) and was not accepted.

c150 create/cancel/edit r1-r2 (labels c150, c150r2): Preview/Reload controls offscreen aborted runs midway; the c150 note body became "...[CANCELLED DRAFT] [edited at 150] [edited at 150]" through these partial runs. Not accepted; superseded by clean note "Fictional note 150-clean" (label c150b). The c150/c150r3 cancel and edit cells still passed their own oracles but are not the accepted 150% cell.
one sqlite read-only oracle read returned "attempt to write a readonly database" while the app was mid-write; the oracle now retries; no result relied on that read.

teardown.focusAndWorkspaceRestored: All 29 recorded active-window/active-workspace/focused-output predicates passed; cursor position and full workspace inventory were not restored. The initial empty workspace 1 disappeared.
